scripts.prepare-dist: (cd ../.. && npm run build -w app/client) && node stage-media.mjs && node steam-libs.mjs
scripts.dist: export TRIVIA_MODDING_FILTER='**/*' TRIVIA_CLIENT_DIST=dist TRIVIA_DATA_DIR=../data TRIVIA_MEDIA_DIR=build/media && npm run prepare-dist && electron-builder --x64 --linux tar.gz --win zip
scripts.dist:dir: export TRIVIA_MODDING_FILTER='**/*' TRIVIA_CLIENT_DIST=dist TRIVIA_DATA_DIR=../data TRIVIA_MEDIA_DIR=build/media && npm run prepare-dist && electron-builder --x64 --linux tar.gz dir --win zip dir
scripts.dist:demo: export TRIVIA_MODDING_FILTER='!**/*' TRIVIA_CLIENT_DIST=dist-demo TRIVIA_DATA_DIR=build/data-demo TRIVIA_MEDIA_DIR=build/media-demo TRIVIA_DEMO=1 && npm run prepare-dist && electron-builder --config electron-builder.demo.yml --x64 --linux tar.gz --win zip
scripts.dist:dir:demo: export TRIVIA_MODDING_FILTER='!**/*' TRIVIA_CLIENT_DIST=dist-demo TRIVIA_DATA_DIR=build/data-demo TRIVIA_MEDIA_DIR=build/media-demo TRIVIA_DEMO=1 && npm run prepare-dist && electron-builder --config electron-builder.demo.yml --x64 --linux tar.gz dir --win zip dir
